summary:
Every finding that is real is fixed in the copy /home/wanhr/sglang/agent_cache/frozen/impl_unified_A: the five bugs, the three estimator weaknesses, the two default-off test gaps and all but one of the other test gaps. Three findings are rejected, each with its reason. Checked on CPU only; nothing ran on a GPU or a server.

What the checks show on the final code:
- **Switches off:** the nine test files pass, the base snapshot's unmodified test files pass on the fixed engine with the baseline counts, and the engineer's side-by-side replay still finds 40,628 log lines and 48,226 answers equal.
- **Only the prices log on:** host eviction takes the same leaves as with it off, on a stub tree and on a real CPU tree. The replay is equal apart from its prices lines and the two ntp_admit fields.
- **Tests:** 34 added (225 to 259 in the five changed test files). Of 93 injected regressions (16 behaviours fixed in this round, the engineer's 33, the reviewers' 44), 90 are caught. The other 3 are two that change no behaviour and one corner left without a test.

The fixes changed what four switches do:
- **LATENESS_WEIGHT and READ_LINE** are now off in mode observe, as the other decision switches are.
- **MEASURED_PRICES** is refused at startup under an eviction policy other than next_use or return_chance when reads are staged by expected cost or held by quantile. Its room price no longer feeds on pending writes and counts a queued turn's history by the wait it has left; its admission error leaves out turns that found the queue empty.
- **RECOMPUTE_WHEN_STARVED** gives up at most one read per half second, and weighs a turn only once it is registered as queued.
- **FREE_EMPTY_LOOKUPS** drops its mark of where storage ends once the match is past it.

Three fixes depart from the plan's pseudo-diffs; items 7, 8 and 10 of the fixed list say why.

Needs attention:
1. **REPORT.md was not updated by me.** A subagent may not write report files, and the main session saved the engineer's report the same way; this output is the update.
2. **The staged merge is stale.** /home/wanhr/sglang/agent_cache/frozen/impl_unified_merged (4:24 PM ET on 26 November) predates all of this and must be run again before an engine copy is frozen from it. Copy A's change set now also holds evict_policy.py.

My check scripts and their outputs are in /home/wanhr/sglang/agent_cache/results/design_unified_1126/impl/A/fix/. I wrote nothing outside the copy and that folder, ran no git write and used no network.
fixed: 1. Logic reviewer, finding 1 (bug). With READ_LINE on, the queue check walked the parked reads for every queued planned turn on every pass, for values that are only logged, and counted a turn's own parked read twice. The line is now counted once when the turn is first marked due and once when a refetch is handed back (`_queued_line_seconds` in next_turn_prefetch.py), and a read of the turn's own that is already parked stands in the line. With the reviewer's timing script, 60 queued planned turns and 43 parked reads cost 124 us a tick with READ_LINE against 83 us with the switches off (it was 800 against 115); 120 turns and 100 reads cost 210 against 148 (it was 3,070 against 200). Test: TestReadLine.test_the_queue_check_counts_the_line_once_a_turn_and_not_the_turns_own_read.

2. Logic 2, default-off 1, style 1 (bug). Pricing a host eviction victim adopted nodes into sessions, so the prices log alone changed which leaf eviction took under return_chance. `ReturnChanceStrategy.holding_rate` now resolves the session without adopting (`_session_registration(node, adopt=False)`). `FullComponent.next_host_victim` ranks through a new read-only `EvictionStrategy.peek_priority` (evict_policy.py; return_chance overrides it) and keeps the session-ref order. On the fixed copy the default-off reviewer's four checks pass, the real tree among them (its fifth test patches the old function signature and no longer applies), and the style reviewer's two pass. Tests: TestPricingLeavesEvictionAlone (the stub tree with the observer a prefetcher binds when only the log is on; naming the next victim; a real CPU tree), TestHostEvictionObserver.test_the_next_victim_follows_session_refs_as_eviction_does, TestHoldingRate.test_return_chance_rate_is_the_sessions_whichever_of_its_nodes_goes.

3. Logic 3 (bug). After the starved-GPU rule gave a read up, its 0.5 s wait did not start again when admission took the dropped turn within the pass. A drop now restarts the wait. The reviewer's script shows one drop at 1.600 s and none in the next 125 ms (it was five in 100 ms). Test: TestRecomputeWhenStarved.test_after_a_drop_the_queue_must_starve_for_another_half_second.

4. Logic 4 (bug). The starved-GPU rule ran before the pass's arrivals were registered, so a turn was weighed by the deadline of the staged read it had joined. `_gpu_starved` now keeps the wait before the queue loop and `_relieve_starved_gpu` acts after it, when every parked read has the deadline dispatch orders it by. The reviewer's turn x keeps its read whichever tick first sees it. Test: TestRecomputeWhenStarved.test_a_turn_is_weighed_by_the_deadline_it_has_once_it_is_queued.

5. Logic 5 (bug). The mark of where storage ends outlived a match that grew past it. The gate now drops the mark when the match is past it, and the queue check drops it when memory reaches past it (`_probe_missing`). The fifo-order shortcut before the probe uses the length without the mark (`_queued_chain`). Test: TestFreeEmptyLookups.test_a_match_that_grew_past_the_mark_opens_what_lies_beyond_it.

6. Logic 6 (nit). Turns that arrived to an empty queue (predicted wait 0 by rule) filled the error bin the hold reads for waits under 2 s. `PriceMeter.observe_admission` now leaves them out; readers still feed the landing lag. With the reviewer's numbers the margin at a predicted 1.5 s is +1.02 s at q = 0.05 and +0.72 s at q = 0.1 (it was +0.19 s and 0.00 s). The err_ fields of the prices line leave these turns out too. Test: TestMeasuredPrices.test_the_admission_error_is_fed_by_turns_that_read_nothing_with_readers_apart (rewritten).

7. Logic 7 (nit). The frontier price fed on itself through kappa's pending-write term. The restore cost behind lam is now price-free, c x (1 + late reads) x read seconds per token (`PriceBoard.kappa_of_reads`); the logged kappa keeps both terms. This departs from 01_PR1_prices.diff and follows DESIGN_v2.md section 7. In the reviewer's scenario lam stays at the price-free value at all four loop gains (it reached the ceiling of 1e-3 at gain 1.95). Test: TestMeasuredPrices.test_the_room_price_does_not_feed_on_the_writes_it_prices.

8. Logic 8 (nit), in two parts. (a) A queued turn's history now sets a price at the frontier, by the wait it has left (`queued_holding_rate` in next_use_eviction.py). Under queued_order farthest the victim is the last arrival, which waits for the whole queue; under lru it is the turn nearest admission, so the top rate. I did not use the top rate for both, as the finding proposed: campaign 40's unified arm runs queued_order farthest, where the top rate overstates the index by wait / 0.5 s (40 times at a 20 s queue) and would push the hold's quantile to its upper clamp. This also departs from the plan, which left queued victims unpriced. (b) MEASURED_PRICES is refused at construction when the eviction policy gives no holding rates and a staged or held read would take the room price. Tests: TestMeasuredPrices.test_a_queued_turns_history_is_priced_by_the_wait_it_has_left, two new cases in TestHoldingRate, TestOwnerSwitches.test_measured_prices_need_an_eviction_policy_that_prices_its_holders.

9. Default-off 2 and 3 (test gaps). TestPricesLogOnly runs one script (a saturated spell, a held read, a staged read, a refused read) with and without the log and compares every start, hold time, harm charge and line. It also pins the switched-off field lists of ec_start and ntp_hold. It catches the reviewer's five mutants.

10. Default-off 4 and style 12. LATENESS_WEIGHT and READ_LINE are now gated on mode on, so the docstring of next_turn_switches.py is true. This departs from the pseudo-diffs, which left both ungated without meaning to: under 03_F2 the prices log would have decided whether the lateness weight applies in observe. Tests: TestOwnerSwitches.test_in_mode_observe_only_the_prices_log_works; price learning 'on' is now refused in a test beside 'harm'.

11. Style 2 to 10 (test gaps): 27 more cases, each red on the reviewer's mutant. Free empty lookups: a match past the key, a hit under the threshold, the ntp_lookup line, a free room retry with ROOM_RETRY on. Measuring: a landing under next_use, landings of unknown requests, unplanned queued turns, a reader with no landing seen, aborts. Measured prices: the frontier price in a staging, the half-second re-pricing and the ceiling of the next victim, return_chance, stale queued registrations, the harm at a fitted cost other than the seed, the fit's forgetting. The prices line: its full ordered field list, hold counts per line, the fifo read order. The starved rule: a fresh ready turn, the wait restarting, unmeasured lags, the write hold, no refetch after a drop. The read line: the write hold for a timed read and not for one needed now, ntp_due's pages for pending and queued turns, a timed read due earlier under expected-cost staging. The gate: arrivals in mu, the line in the read time. TestGateOnTheRealCache: the prompt gate and the prices log on the real CPU cache.

12. Style 11, 14, 16, 18, 19. The unused `import re` is gone. The design is cited by title, without section numbers. The six functions named take their later arguments by keyword only. The three stale docstrings are current, and the prefetcher, not the meter, now binds the eviction observer and the lag measuring, so the meter only reads. 'today' reads 'without the switch'.

13. Style 15, in part. The helper docstrings named are cut to two lines (one keeps three, for a tuple of three values), the meter's two are now comments, and the tests added in this round carry two-line docstrings.
14. Style 17, in part. The cache's gate call and lookup report are two small methods (`_prefetch_gate_allows`, `_report_storage_lookup`), so the two long functions now grow by 2 lines and 1 line net.

Style 2, item 4, first half (a test for the free room retry clearing lookup_charged): not written, because the line cannot be reached with the mark set. A retry needs room_refused; only a refusal sets it; a refusal follows a found answer, and every reported answer clears the mark; any later charged call clears room_refused. The line is left in place.
